title: En calidad de: el estatus formal con el que algo actúa

sections.content: En calidad de (in the capacity of, as) names the formal status or role in which something is being described or acting -- useful in legal and constitutional writing that needs to be precise about status. It's followed by a noun phrase. These sentences are taken directly from the previous reading.

items.spanish: La constitución colombiana definió a Colombia, en calidad de nación, como un país multiétnico y pluricultural.
items.english: The Colombian constitution defined Colombia, in its capacity as a nation, as a multiethnic and pluricultural country.

items.spanish: Bolivia se redefinió a sí misma, en calidad de Estado, como un "Estado Plurinacional".
items.english: Bolivia redefined itself, in its capacity as a state, as a "Plurinational State".

items.spanish: El representante indígena participó en las negociaciones en calidad de observador oficial.
items.english: The Indigenous representative took part in the negotiations in the capacity of official observer.

items.spanish: Este documento fue presentado en calidad de propuesta, no como una decisión ya tomada.
items.english: This document was presented in the capacity of a proposal, not as an already-made decision.

sections.content: En calidad de is more formal and precise than como -- reach for it in legal, constitutional, or institutional writing where the exact formal status matters, not just a loose comparison.
